name: Zuni original grant (Royce Area 681)
citation: No Act of Congress confirmed it: Royce lists it as 'Spanish grant 1689; 17,581.25 acres' in the block headed 'Act of Congress, Stat. L. XI, 374', but Zuni is not among the claims in that Act
promises: Royce records a Spanish grant of 1689 of 17,581.25 acres around the Zuni pueblo. Congress did not confirm it; the Act of December 22, 1858 does not name Zuni.
The Claims Court found in 1987 that historians generally agree the 1689 Zuni grant document was forged, possibly in the late Mexican period.
today: The pueblo area lies within the Zuni Reservation set apart by executive order of March 16, 1877 (researched as cession-1877-03-16-zu-i). In Zuni Tribe v. United States (1987) the Claims Court found Zuni aboriginal title to a far larger area and that the United States treated land outside the central pueblo area as public domain; the tribe excluded the present reservation from that claim, which ended in a $25,000,000 judgment in 1991. That finding concerns land outside this grant and is not counted here.

openQuestions: Audit 2026-11-08: wording fixed; the first open question said the 1858 Act confirmed this grant, which contradicts the Act's text (Zuni is not among its listed claims, govinfo page checked).

The date 1886-10-01 in treaties.json is not an event date for this land. Royce prints the Pueblo grants under a block headed 'Oct. 1, Act of Congress, Stat. L. XI, 374'; 11 Stat. 374 is the Act of December 22, 1858, which confirmed other pueblos' grants. This is land the Pueblo kept, not land it ceded. Not edited. Zuni is not one of the claims in 11 Stat. 374, so treaties.json's statute link for this row does not fit it.

This record is the same pueblo area as part of the 1877 reservation (cession-1877-03-16-zu-i) but a different event (Royce's grant listing); not marked sameEventAs. The $25,000,000 judgment of January 22, 1991 is taken from that file, not reread here.
The Pueblo of Zuni's own account was not located: ashiwi.org loaded with no land history.
Royce's 'Zuni (original grant)' row gives no confirming act; how the 17,581.25 acres were measured was not found.

2026-11-08 sweep: Court of Claims and ICC full text searched for Pueblo, Zuni, Zuni grant; the Zuni Court of Claims entries (1981) are procedural orders in the aboriginal-title and trust suits; the ICC aboriginal-title decisions found expressly exclude the confirmed grants (e.g. 30 Ind. Cl. Comm. 234, 1973), so nothing new inside this grant.
